main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: Free Yourself from the Demiurge's Illusion
header_desc: By intertwining 1st century spirituality with 21st century physics, this work addresses the fundamental question about our place in the cosmos. The solution to quantum gravity is revealed in texts two thousand years old: the Gnostic Gospels. The ego has mass; therefore, by shedding it, we allow ourselves to transcend matter.
left_title: The Pleroma is a flat space-time and the prison a curved one
left_body: Matter tells space-time how to curve, and space-time tells matter how to move. If the ego curves space-time, the cosmic time plane emerges from our psyche, and the timeless responds to the pneuma. Consciousness oscillates between the states | ONE ⟩ and | EGO ⟩, granting us free will of perception formalized in the inner product ⟨ ONE | EGO ⟩. In this context, the premise that the Father and I are one becomes a profound invitation to shed the false self to return to the flat light of the Invisible Father.
universe_light_text: The revelation that the Father is the universe and that death does not exist frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere resides the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩. There lies the land of union and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: The Kingdom of God is inside you and outside you — Gospel of Thomas (Logon 3): the wisdom of Sophia in the right hemisphere versus the ignorance of Yaldabaoth in the left hemisphere reveal the duality of human consciousness.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩. Gravitational force drags us to a place where: war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength (1984).
final_quote: The Christian cross is a key ✝️ to awaken ❤️ from the illusion of time 🧠
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: The Flight of Science and Spirituality
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)
cap1_desc: Premise and integration framework: the reconciliation between the intuitive wisdom of the South (the heart, ancestral knowledge, and spirit) and the technological development of the North (reason, science, and mind). The call for balance to initiate the evolutionary awakening and transcend the state of duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and Illusion of Time (01:13 -- 02:42)
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity versus Quantum Mechanics. Why Newton's and Maxwell's laws do not distinguish between past and future, Einstein's rupture of simultaneity, and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_desc: The conceptual Faggin--Segarra assembly: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside space-time, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not arise from the brain but precedes it, converging with the First Consciousness and the Intelligent Designer free of time and space.
cap4_desc: The discovery of Nag Hammadi (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as home, but as the soul's imprisonment. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to found a religion of dogmas, but to free the inner spark from the Demiurge's prison through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Pleroma of Light and The Material Prison (08:43 -- 10:16)
cap5_desc: The time of no-time and the awakening announced by the Mayan cosmogony. The cosmological question about the origin of Yaldabaoth and the revelation of the Pleroma: the transcendent realm of perfection, silence, and pure light where the Invisible Father resides, emanated through Sophia (wisdom).
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and the Cerebral Hemispheres (10:23 -- 14:38)
cap6_desc: Compared eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The mechanism of Orwellian doublethink (1984) as the ego's cognitive prison, versus Jesus' revolutionary message that dismantles the imperial slavery system.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos (14:40 -- 16:30)
cap7_desc: The capital affirmation: I am the way, the truth, and the life; the Father and I are one (John 14:6). The confrontation with the question of questions: Is Jesus God in an immeasurable universe of more than two trillion galaxies? The paradox of cosmic incarnation on a tiny planet.
sagan_quote: The idea that God is a white man, bigger than normal, with a flaming beard, sitting in the sky and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one means the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then such a God clearly exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... there is not much sense in praying to the law of gravity.
